qa_pairs.question: What are the three types of welds shown in the welding procedure images?
qa_pairs.answer: The three types of welds shown are: insert gas plug weld front wall on engine carrier (shown in two different views), and insert gas weld front wall on end plate.

qa_pairs.question: What part numbers are referenced for the welding procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: The part numbers referenced are 30 41 042, 30 41 043, and 30 41 044.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the gas plug weld be inserted on the engine carrier?
qa_pairs.answer: The gas plug weld should be inserted on the front wall of the engine carrier.

qa_pairs.question: What material should be applied to mating surfaces and joints during body work?
qa_pairs.answer: Body sealing compound should be applied to all mating surfaces and joints.

qa_pairs.question: What is the source reference cited at the bottom of the page?
qa_pairs.answer: The source reference cited is HWB.

qa_pairs.question: What type of weld is used on the end plate?
qa_pairs.answer: An insert gas weld is used on the front wall of the end plate.

qa_pairs.question: What should be coated with body sealing compound?
qa_pairs.answer: All mating surfaces and joints should be coated with body sealing compound.

qa_pairs.question: How many different welding operations are illustrated on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different welding operations are illustrated: two for gas plug welds on the engine carrier front wall and one for gas weld on the end plate.

qa_pairs.question: What page number is shown at the top of this manual page?
What part number corresponds to the end plate welding procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Part number 30 41 044 corresponds to the end plate welding procedure.

qa_pairs.question: What type of compound is specified for sealing body joints?
qa_pairs.answer: A body sealing compound is specified for coating all mating surfaces and joints.

qa_pairs.question: Which welding procedure shows the final sealing step?
qa_pairs.answer: The final image (30 41 045) shows the sealing step where all mating surfaces and joints are coated with body sealing compound.
